claims: Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
The final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
TV coverage of Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is from 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Early streaming coverage of Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is from 10 a.m.-2 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, and Paramount+.
Featured groups and holes coverage of Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is from 10:15 a.m.-7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
TV coverage of the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is from 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Early streaming coverage of the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is from 10 a.m.-2 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+.
Featured groups and holes coverage of the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is from 10:15 a.m.-7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Paramount+ offers live coverage of the CBS broadcast.
Masters.com and the Masters App offer free live streams of featured groups, holes 4, 5, 6, and Amen Corner.
Amazon Prime Video carries featured coverage.
